name: 潦草急救
description: 用【平静】和【暴怒】填满自己的手牌。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var sourcePiece = context.piece; var player = battle.players.find(function(p) { return p.playerId === sourcePiece.ownerPlayerId; }); if (!player) return { message: '找不到玩家', success: false }; if (!player.hand) player.hand = []; var maxHand = 10; var added = 0; var calm = 0; var rage = 0; var cards = ['watcher-calm', 'watcher-rage']; var i = 0; while (player.hand.length < maxHand) { addCardToHand(cards[i % 2], sourcePiece.ownerPlayerId); added++; if (i % 2 === 0) calm++; else rage++; i++; } if (added === 0) return { message: sourcePiece.name + '手牌已满，无法使用潦草急救', success: false }; return { message: sourcePiece.name + '释放潦草急救，手牌被平静(' + calm + ')和暴怒(' + rage + ')填满', success: true }; }
